channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Flávio no STF', sugere Eduardo Bolsonaro, com montagem do irmão como ministro da Corte
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro proposed that his brother Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, take a seat at the STF. The suggestion was made in a social media post, amid the 2026 election race.

item.title: Os dilemas da campanha de Lula no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Lula's campaign in Rio de Janeiro faces criticism over lack of street visibility, with few petista stickers and flags visible. Candidates and militants question the strategy amid a technical tie in the state and recent polling gains by Flávio Bolsonaro. The lack of coordination with Eduardo Paes' PSD is cited as justification, while Flávio and Douglas Ruas maintain stronger physical campaigning.

item.title: Alejandro Domínguez parabeniza Brasil após classificação no Mundial Sub-20
item.description: Alejandro Domínguez, CONMEBOL president, congratulated the Brazilian Under-20 Women's National Team on advancing to the 2026 FIFA World Cup quarterfinals after winning a penalty shootout against the United States. Their next opponent will be Spain, in a match scheduled for September 19 in Poland.

item.title: Lula deve abordar interferências externas durante discurso na ONU
item.description: Lula will advocate for non-interference in internal affairs during his UN speech. The president will call for peace from Security Council permanent members and emphasize multilateralism. No meetings with other heads of state have been scheduled yet.

item.title: Ipsos-Ipec: 43% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo, 33% como ótimo ou bom e 23% como regular
item.description: An Ipsos-Ipec survey from September 2026 shows that 43% of Brazilians rate the Lula government as bad or terrible, while 33% see it as great or good and 23% as regular. Disapproval of Lula's management also rose to 53%, with 57% saying they do not trust the president. Economic perception worsened, with 45% saying the situation is worse than six months ago.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Julgamento de Moraes no STF mobiliza redes com 2,5 milhões de menções, diz Bites
item.description: The Supreme Court trial involving Alexandre de Moraes generated 2.5 million social media mentions, according to Bites consultancy. The plenary session drove high YouTube viewership and a record in Google searches for the STF, outperforming interest in Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The judicial crisis kept the Supreme Court at the center of political debate in the final stretch of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Michelle responde a Sebastião Coelho e nega plano de deixar Senado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL-DF) denied, through a statement, having plans to leave the Senate if elected, refuting statements made by Sebastião Coelho. She claimed that her and Bia Kicis' candidacies reflect Jair Bolsonaro's will, and noted campaign limitations due to STF decisions restricting her movements. Michelle emphasized her intent to work for the vulnerable and uphold the Constitution if elected.

item.title: O caminho para Flávio tirar Bolsonaro da prisão começou com o julgamento do STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's path to freeing his father began with the STF trial. His strategy involves challenging proceedings and potentially revising convictions, creating room for a win that would strengthen the far-right and weaken the Court, especially Moraes.

item.title: MJ monitora fala de Trump sobre PCC e CV e discute tema em reunião
item.description: The Ministry of Justice and Public Security is monitoring statements by Donald Trump regarding crackdown efforts against the PCC and Comando Vermelho, following the U.S. government's designation of these factions as foreign terrorist organizations and criticism of Brazil's alleged failure in combating drug trafficking. The discussion unfolds amid a U.S. decree excluding Brazil from the list of drug-producing countries, yet accusing it of becoming a global hub for cocaine distribution. The issue was discussed internally at the ministry on Wednesday.

item.title: ‘Flávio no STF’, sugere Eduardo Bolsonaro, com montagem do irmão como ministro da Corte
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro proposed Flávio Bolsonaro as a Supreme Court minister, highlighting an open vacancy and questioning the impartiality of future appointments. He also mentioned the possibility of Flávio, if elected president, appointing ministers to the next four vacancies in the Court, requiring resignation to assume the role. The suggestion was made via social media without detailed explanations on how the process would work.

item.title: Nova disparada do diesel põe em xeque pacote de Lula para segurar preços
item.description: The fresh spike in international diesel prices widened the gap between global benchmarks and Petrobras prices, pressuring the government's fuel price containment package. A one-real-per-liter subsidy is no longer sufficient due to rising refining margins in Asia and global supply disruptions. The situation threatens supply since 30% of Brazil's diesel relies on imports.

item.title: Brasil cobra dos EUA andamento de notificação de Paulo Figueiredo
item.description: The Brazilian Ministry of Justice informed the Supreme Federal Court that it has not yet received a response from U.S. authorities regarding the personal notification of Paulo Figueiredo, charged in connection with the 2022 coup attempt. A request under Letter Rogatory No. 8/2025 was sent in November 2025, and by September 15, 2026, no reply had been received. The Public Prosecutor's Office also indicted Figueiredo and Eduardo Bolsonaro for obstruction of justice.

item.title: Crise no STF: Caiado fala em "mãos sujas" de Lula, mas não poupa Flávio
item.description: Candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio for lacking moral authority, highlighting investigations involving both. He deemed the country ungovernable with these two opponents and demanded that Lula had made a statement on the STF crisis. Caiado also questioned the conduct of STF president Edson Fachin during the session dealing with the suspension of an investigation against minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula diz que Moraes tem "obrigação" de se explicar
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, campaign coordinator for Lula in São Paulo, stated that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has an 'obligation' to explain his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro. While acknowledging Moraes' role in defending democracy, he emphasized this does not exempt the minister from accountability. Carvalho stressed that the revealed crisis does not involve the Lula government, Banco Master, or the STF as an institution.

item.title: Eleições 2026: PRF restringe bloqueios em rodovias nos dias de votação
item.description: The PRF restricted roadside inspections on election days in 2026 to ensure voters' free movement, preventing unjustified roadblocks and detentions. In 2022, the PRF was convicted for defying TSE orders and blocking buses transporting voters, with former director Silvinei Vasques sentenced for attempting to influence the election outcome. The new rule aims to prevent future institutional abuses during the vote.

item.title: Botafogo confirma Tite como novo técnico para sequência de 2026
item.description: Botafogo confirmed the hiring of Tite as head coach for the 2026 season sequence. The two-year contract, lasting until 2028, marks Tite's second stint with the Rio-based club. The technical staff will include assistants Marcello Sales and Rodrigo Bellão.

item.title: Bolsa tem maior retorno sob Lula 3 do que sob Bolsonaro, diz estudo
item.description: A study by Elos Ayta consultancy compares stock market returns during the third terms of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Jair Bolsonaro, showing better performance under Lula in indices such as Ibovespa, IDIV, BDRX, IFIX and CDI. The analysis also reveals that the dollar and euro depreciated less during Lula's term, while the IPCA was lower compared to Bolsonaro's period.

item.title: Lula sanciona incentivos para minerais críticos no Brasil
item.description: President Lula signed the creation of the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals, providing R$ 7 billion in incentives to boost domestic processing and transformation of minerals such as lithium, nickel, and rare earths. The policy aims to increase Brazil's position in the mineral value chain and attract foreign investment in strategic sectors like batteries and electric vehicles.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba a ordem dos votos na urna eletrônica
item.description: In the 2026 general elections, voters must cast six votes on the electronic ballot box, in this order: federal deputy, state or district deputy, two senators, governor, and president. Voting takes place from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with the right to vote guaranteed for those in line at closing time. The vote sequence and a one-second safety pause when confirming the vote are set by the TSE to ensure transparency and prevent mistakes.

item.title: “Agora a gente vai saber quem foi fazer suruba”, diz Lula sobre caso Master
item.description: President Lula stated that the Banco Master scandal will expose political entanglements, including criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. He likened the events to 'pure orgy' and suggested information about alleged irregularities will be released. The investigation aims to clarify connections between politicians and former banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula diz que usava “sangue de Cristo” para explicar vermelho do PT
item.description: President Lula stated he used 'the blood of Christ' to explain the red color of the PT flag and advocated for women's inclusion in the Catholic Church, highlighting differences between Catholics and Protestants. He also reiterated his stance against holding rallies in churches and announced he will address issues like wars and inequality at the upcoming UN General Assembly.

item.title: Lula chama Trump de 'amigo' e diz que o alertou para não interferir nas eleições do Brasil
item.description: President Lula referred to Trump as a friend and stated he warned against interference in the Brazilian elections. Trump, the former U.S. president, has previously faced criticism for alleged comments about the vote. The statement comes amid rising political and international tensions over the transparency of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Lula diz a pastores que vermelho do PT é 'sangue de Cristo' e barba é alusão a Jesus
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) told evangelical pastors that the Party's red color symbolizes the blood of Jesus Christ, while his beard is a reference to the Son of God. The statement was made during a meeting with religious leaders on April 16.

item.title: Ibram propõe a conselho de minerais critérios usados em outros países
item.description: The Brazilian Mining Institute (Ibram) proposed international criteria to the federal government to guide the newly created National Council for the Industrialization of Critical and Strategic Minerals, seeking a balance between strategic oversight and routine industry operations. The bill will be sanctioned by President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva in a ceremony at the Planalto, establishing a body with the authority to evaluate corporate transfers and international contracts involving strategic minerals.

item.title: A ofensiva da oposição para mudar tramitação de impeachment de ministros do STF no Senado
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, proposes a bill to automatically process STF minister impeachments in the Senate with 49 senators' support, bypassing the Senate president's discretion. The move targets Davi Alcolumbre, who has so far ignored requests to suspend Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: EUA diz que Brasil falhou no combate ao tráfico e cita PCC e Comando Vermelho
item.description: The US government classified Brazil as having failed in the fight against drug trafficking, citing the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. The presidential determination sent to Congress states that these factions have turned Brazil into a global hub for cocaine trafficking. The designation of the factions as terrorists followed a request by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during a meeting with Donald Trump.

item.title: O plano é livrar Vorcaro da cadeia depois de livrar Moraes de
item.description: A plan seeks to free Daniel Vorcaro from jail after removing Alexandre de Moraes from the investigation, using rapporteur disqualifications and tactics similar to those used against the Car Wash operation. The STF session was marked by criticism of judicial impartiality and institutional crisis ahead of elections.

item.title: Já vimos esse filme (por Mirian Guaraciaba)
item.description: Quaest released a poll favoring Flávio Bolsonauro after a meeting between its director and the candidate, while other institutes show Lula leading in the second round. The text questions possible manipulations and warns about press freedom.

item.title: Um dia após sessão do STF, Eduardo se reúne com governo Trump
item.description: A day after the STF halted the trial of Alexandre de Moraes, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo meet with Trump administration officials in Washington to discuss investigations and Magnitsky sanctions.

item.title: A responsabilidade de Lula sobre a sessão que blindou Alexandre de Moraes no STF
item.description: During a Supreme Court session addressing investigations into Minister Alexandre de Moraes, the justices appointed by Lula, Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino, played key roles in a strategy that prevented the establishment of a formal inquiry. The strategy involved leaking sensitive data and introducing preliminary objections, causing chaos and halting the session. Lula subsequently distanced himself from Moraes during a press conference.

item.title: O Supremo pode ser juiz de sua própria crise?
item.description: The STF session on Petition 16.662, related to messages attributed to Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, ended without judging the merits, only deciding to separate the cases of André Mendonça. The case reveals institutional challenges of how the Court investigates its own justices. Elements mention suspicious payments involving relatives of ministers such as Kevin Marques and Rodrigo Fux, with companies denying irregularities.

item.title: Quaest: 49% não consideram Lula honesto; 42% dizem o mesmo sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A Quaest poll reveals that 49% of Brazilians do not consider Lula honest, while 42% hold the same view toward Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula has 28% who view him as honest, compared to Flávio’s 23%. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 2,004 people between September 10 and 13, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: JOTA Principal | STF não aponta saída para crise com vista de Dino que adia decisão sobre Moraes
item.description: The STF remained tense after Flávio Dino's request to postpone the decision on an investigation into Moraes, with no set date. The session exposed divisions among justices, marked by verbal confrontations and political alignments affecting the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Julgamento de Moraes escancara guerra no STF, sem sinais de trégua
item.description: The Supreme Court trial regarding the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes remains tense with no signs of de-escalation. Despite Flávio Dino's request to set aside the case, justices confirmed their divergent positions, criticizing André Mendonça over the handling of the Banco Master inquiry. The case raises electoral tensions amid the upcoming election and involves figures such as Nunes Marques and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A ressaca cívica é porque a truculência e a chantagem venceram o argumento
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court meeting regarding the connections between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro was marked by aggression, blackmail, and rhetorical weapons rather than substantive debate. The ministers' behavior turned the session into a trial of the judges themselves, with leaks, convenient recusals, and attacks on figures such as Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Renaut Geely anuncia investimento de R$ 1,9 bilhão no Brasil
item.description: Renault Geely do Brasil announces an additional investment of R$1.9 billion, raising the total planned between 2025 and 2027 to R$5.35 billion. The funds will support local production of electric models, including the Geely EX2 and a new Renault vehicle, strengthening the partnership between the French and Chinese automakers.

item.title: A audiência recorde da sessão histórica no STF
item.description: The STF's extraordinary session, which addressed a potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes regarding his ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro, became the most-watched video in the court's YouTube history, with 3.2 million views. The debate was interrupted after a motion by Flávio Dino, without progressing in the ruling.

item.title: Integrantes do Judiciário não podem ter parentes advogando, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with Record that members of the judiciary, including Supreme Court justices, should not have relatives practicing law, emphasizing the need for 'moralization' of the judiciary and criticizing potential conflicts of interest. He also advocated for a deep reform of the judiciary, addressing issues such as term limits and selection criteria, highlighting the importance of the Supreme Court being a 'magnanimous example' for the country. His remarks were made amid proceedings involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quarta-feira (16)
item.description: On Wednesday (16th), the presidential candidates carry out their campaign schedule with rallies, processions, leafleting, and interviews on podcasts, radio, and TV, as well as meetings with supporters in various cities. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) stand out with events in CE and DF; other candidates such as Zema (Novo), Caiado (PSD), Samara Martins (UP), and Wilson Grassi (Democrata) are also mobilizing. Clariana Barão (DC), Rui Costa Pimenta (PCO), and Leonardo Avalanche (PRTB) do not disclose public schedules.

item.title: Sessão desastrosa do STF influenciará o voto e reduz confiança na democracia
item.description: A session plagued by personal conflicts and tactics to avoid decisions sparked criticism of the STF's management and reinforced 'civic unrest' voiced by Justice Cármen Lúcia. Debates over messages between justices and judicial procedures were postponed, polarizing views on institutional integrity.

item.title: Seleção feminina anuncia amistosos contra Argentina em Porto Alegre e Recife
item.description: The CBF announced friendly matches for the Brazilian women's team against Argentina on October 10 at Beira-Rio in Porto Alegre and October 13 at Arena Pernambuco in Recife. In November and December, Brazil will face Japan in Hiroshima and Okayama. Coach Arthur Elias highlighted Argentina's evolution and the challenge posed by Japan.

item.title: Vitória momentânea de Moraes e Fachin acuado: o saldo da sessão do STF sobre caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Judges aligned with Moraes, including Gilmar Mendes and Flávio Dino, voted 4 to 3 to postpone the trial of an action involving Moraes and Vorcaro, avoiding a direct clash with Justice André Mendonça. The session exposed Fachin's struggles to contain his colleagues' interventions, highlighting the strategic divide within the STF during a politically sensitive electoral period.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula sanciona política para minerais e Flávio Bolsonaro visita Ceará e Pernambuco
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro lead separate campaign schedules in the Northeast and Federal District. The president signs a critical minerals policy and attends an event in Ceilândia; the senator tours CE and PE with rallies and walkabouts. Other candidates also hold interviews and regional events.

item.title: Imprensa internacional destaca crise no STF às vésperas das eleições
item.description: International press highlighted the crisis at the Brazilian Supreme Court ahead of elections, following a tense session over the potential investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The decision was postponed, adding uncertainty to an already polarized electoral context.

item.title: Com apoio de Eduardo, advogado de Zambelli leva Moraes ao Tribunal de Haia
item.description: Carla Zambelli's lawyer, Fábio Pagnozzi, filed a complaint against Justice Alexandre de Moraes at the International Criminal Court, backed by Eduardo Bolsonaro and Eduardo Tagliaferro. The accusation involves alleged arrests and political persecution of opponents, while the STF reviews investigations into the minister. Eduardo Bolsonaro also sought U.S. support for sanctions under the Magnitsky Act.

item.title: “Vaquinha” do Waze vira alerta para campanhas eleitorais nas ruas: entenda
item.description: Waze users have been using the 'cow' alert to indicate the presence of electoral campaigns on the streets, a practice identified in several Brazilian cities. Originally designed to warn about traffic obstacles, the feature is being repurposed to inform about political rallies and demonstrations. The newspaper sought a comment from Waze, but the company had not responded by the time of publication.

item.title: O advogado que faz a ponte entre Gilmar Mendes e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lawyer Rodrigo Mudrovitsch, currently president of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights, serves as a bridge between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, maintaining good relationships with both despite their opposing political paths. He was nominated to the Inter-American Court by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020 and has also worked as Gilmar's attorney in legal cases, in addition to teaching at IDP, an institution founded by Gilmar. There is speculation that Mudrovitsch could be nominated to fill Gilmar's seat on the Supreme Court in 2030 if Flávio wins the presidency in 2026.

item.title: Trump pierde en el Supremo la batalla del voto por correo, pero sigue su guerra para subvertir las ‘midterms’
item.description: Donald Trump lost a Supreme Court case regarding mail-in voting but continues attempting to influence the November legislative elections in the US. His strategy includes changing election rules and complicating ballot access, based on unfounded allegations of electoral fraud.

item.title: Campanha de Lula resgata histórico de Moraes para afastá-lo
item.description: Lula's campaign seeks to distance the president from the crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes at the STF by highlighting the minister's historical opposition to the PT before and after joining the Court. The strategy emphasizes that Moraes was appointed by Michel Temer and voted against Lula in 2018, reinforcing no political alignment. The government advocates for investigations into all involved in the Banco Master case without incorporating the crisis into the electoral campaign.

item.title: Dino anuncia prisões e deixa Brasília e advogados em alerta
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino stated he arrived late to the STF session because he was 'ordering arrests,' amid a surge in legal filings. His remark raised concerns among lawyers and officials in Brasília, particularly regarding ongoing cases under his oversight involving high-profile individuals.
